# DCDFLIB

These files are derived from the C release of DCDFLIB (February 1994) by
Barry W. Brown, James Lovato, and Kathy Russell of the University of Texas
M.D. Anderson Cancer Center.

Upstream source: https://www.netlib.org/random/dcdflib.c.tar.gz

The versions shipped here are the C++ adaptations previously built as part of
GCTA, including local type-cast, declaration, and header changes. They are not
an unmodified copy of another CDFLIB distribution. The original legal notice
is preserved in `LICENSE`.
